india_trends.title: NSE IPO listing date, timeline: When ₹30,000 cr issue is expected to hit Indian stock market exchanges
india_trends.summary: The NSE IPO, approved by Sebi, is set to raise around ₹30,000 crore, surpassing previous IPO records. Offering 149 million shares from existing shareholders, the IPO marks a significant milestone after years of delays due to regulatory issues and is expected to list in September 2024.
